findings.claim: WREV9 retail WRLD payload has 331 bytes: eleven 13-byte name slots, three signed selection/projection words, eight 20-byte material rows, and an explicit 16-byte opaque tail.
findings.limitations: Observed layout only; material member+0c and final tail semantics unresolved; physical float labels not established.

findings.claim: ACT/LUM/TBL are direct serialized acquisitions; NPT/sky are retained then used later; SDF, terrain defaults and display map use derived names; HZD is an optional horizon texture manifest and PCF is derived outside WRLD.
findings.limitations: Static acquisition attempts, not asset readability or runtime success; LUM callback mathematics and complete child resource grammars deferred.

findings.claim: All 80 accessible private missions in 40 miss8/miss16 pairs have WREV9, WRLD chunk339/payload331 and WDEF367; 39 pairs differ, including S01 audio selection outside name slots.
findings.limitations: Applies to exactly the hashed unpacked private specimens; not every release, archived source, native game acceptance or mode availability.

findings.claim: WRLD flags1 passes the chunk header to 004b8a10; it uses fixed source displacements without a local payload-length check, performs unbounded name scans and returns1 after side effects.
findings.limitations: Generic parser validation is incomplete separately; no malformed retail execution or whole-program unknown-byte read closure claimed.
